subclassFeature.name: Dracolich Patron
entries: {@i Make a Deal with what is below Sieg}
Your pact draws on the Dracolich of Sieg. You made a pact with them to save yourself and your lover.
When you choose this subclass at 3rd level, you gain the Dracolich Spells and Dreaded Dragon features.

subclassFeature.name: Dracolich Spells
entries: The magic of your patron ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Warlock level specified in the Dracolich Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Dracolich Spells
rows: {@spell bane|xphb}, {@spell cause fear|xge}, {@spell dragon's breath|xphb}, {@spell phantasmal force|xphb}

subclassFeature.name: Dreaded Dragon
entries: You gain the ability to manifest aspects of your patron. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you transform for 1 minute and gain the following benefits.
When you take damage, you gain temporary hp equal to half the damage taken up to a maximum of 10 times your Warlock level until the start of your next turn. This effect may stack upon itself.
When you deal necrotic damage with a spell, you may choose to deal no necrotic damage and instead heal hp equal to half of the amount of necrotic damage you would have dealt.
If a spell you cast does not do necrotic damage, you may choose to deal {@dice 1d10} necrotic damage as part of that spell. Once per spell cast.

subclassFeature.name: Decaying Sustanence
entries: Your patron's power grows more comfortable in your skin. You no longer require food, drink, or breath to sustain your lifeforce.
In addition, if you start your turn with 50 temporary hit points or more, you regain one pact slot.

subclassFeature.name: Immortal Husk
entries: Your connection to The Fallen has saturated your body.
So long as you have immunity to necrotic damage, at dusk each day you may choose a damage type to become immune to until the following dusk.
If you do not have immunity to necrotic damage, you gain it.

subclassFeature.name: Dread Unshackled
entries: Your Dreaded Dragon ability gains the following effects.
While you have temporary hp, you may use a reaction to become resistant to any damage dealt by that attack until dusk.

When you deal necrotic damage, you ignore any resistance it has to necrotic damage. If a creature is immune to necrotic, it is instead resistant. If a creature absorbed necrotic damage, it is instead immune. If a creature is vulnerable to necrotic, you heal hit points equal to the amount of necrotic damage dealt.
The bonus necrotic damage you deal with spells increases to {@dice 2d10}. Once per spell cast.
